name: paste0
title: Paste strings with an empty separator

origin.description: paste with sep of the empty string, including recycle0.

arguments.name: collapse
arguments.text: Placed between the results. NULL leaves them separate.

arguments.name: recycle0
arguments.text: Return an empty result when any argument is empty.

origin.details: An empty argument and recycle0 true returns character(0) when collapse is NULL.
origin.example:
bp_paste0 <- getFromNamespace("paste0", "backports")
print(bp_paste0(letters[1:3], character(), collapse = NULL, recycle0 = TRUE))
print(bp_paste0("a", "b"))
